CFB-week.summary: Midweek MACtion: Tuesday has WMU at Akron, Kent State at Bowling Green and Ohio at Miami (OH); Wednesday has Buffalo at Ball State, Sacramento State at Central Michigan and UMass at Toledo. Player props were thin for these games at research time: only five lines were found with a named book (FanDuel, matched at Bovada/BetOnline), and no availability reports were posted yet.

NBA-BOS-at-PHI-1111.summary: Both teams' rotations are close to intact. Boston listed no injuries, and Philadelphia ruled out only bench big Adem Bona (neck sprain) and Dominick Barlow (back), so the Sixers' starting five is healthy. Embiid is not on the report, but the team is still managing his right-foot plantar fasciitis. He was capped at 25 minutes on Nov 2 and has sat the second game of back-to-backs; tonight is not a back-to-back for Philadelphia.

NBA-MIA-at-UTAH-1111.summary: Utah (1-9, eight straight losses) is without Keyonte George (ankle), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, and Lauri Markkanen is questionable with a re-aggravated wrist sprain (Josh Green starts if he sits), pushing creation to rookie Darryn Peterson. Miami lists only Giannis (probable, wrist) and moved Pelle Larsson into the starting five over Andrew Wiggins on Sunday.

NBA-MIL-at-NY-1111.summary: Both teams list only one player: Josh Hart (right ankle soreness) is questionable for New York after missing two straight games, and Tyler Herro (right knee contusion) is questionable for 1-9 Milwaukee. Hart's status decides whether Landry Shamet keeps his fill-in starting role or returns to the bench.

NBA-OKC-at-POR-1111.summary: Oklahoma City (8-2, four straight wins) remains short-handed: Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, Sorber and now Jaylin Williams (low back spasms) are out, keeping the offense heavily on Gilgeous-Alexander, who is not on the report. Portland (6-3) is without Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci.

fix.summary: Quick checks on unresearched Top 10 picks.

NBA-CLE-at-CHA-1110.summary: Cleveland is without Merrill and Tyson, and Jarrett Allen (knee) is questionable after missing two games; if he sits, Mobley plays center and Watson moves to the four. Charlotte is short-handed with Knueppel, Miller, Schroder and Grant Williams out, so Coby White and Naz Reid carry the offense; Diabate is questionable.

NBA-IND-at-DAL-1110.summary: Indiana remains without Haliburton (hamstring), Sheppard and Furphy, and T.J. McConnell is questionable with a right hamstring strain; Quenton Jackson would get more minutes if he sits, and Braden Smith was the projected starting PG Saturday, not McConnell as the packet shows. Zubac is back from a five-game ankle absence with no reported restriction. Dallas is on a back-to-back after playing Sunday; the Mavericks' Monday report could not be confirmed from a source.

NBA-LAL-at-ATL-1110.summary: Luka Doncic (lower back) is listed out for the Lakers on the second night of a back-to-back, putting Austin Reaves and Collin Sexton in charge of the offense and Quentin Grimes (finger) is questionable. Atlanta is without Newell, Gilbert, Gueye and Veesaar, with Landale questionable after missing four games; Jalen Johnson has no designation.

NBA-NO-at-GS-1110.summary: Golden State is without Will Richard (thumb UCL tear), Porzingis, Butler and Moody, with Gui Santos probable on a sore knee; Curry and Podziemski have no designation. New Orleans lists only Yves Missi (knee, out) and plays the second night of a back-to-back, with Matkovic starting at center.

NBA-SA-at-PHX-1110.summary: San Antonio is without Tobias Harris (calf) and Jayden Quaintance (knee), and Devin Vassell is questionable with left adductor tightness; Champagnie would likely start if he sits. Phoenix remains without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Jordan Goodwin (calf) is out or doubtful, leaving Ighodaro and Maluach to split center.

NBA-WSH-at-DET-1110.summary: Anthony Davis (right ankle sprain) is questionable again after missing the last two games; Vukcevic, Beekman, Champagnie and Watkins are out for Washington. Detroit is without Duren (hamstring, re-evaluated in two weeks) with Reed starting, Isaiah Joe (hip) may return, and the Pistons are on a back-to-back after losing to the Lakers Sunday.

NFL-BUF-at-MIN-1110.summary: Carson Wentz starts for Minnesota with Kyler Murray out (hamstring); WR Jauan Jennings and RB Demond Claiborne are also out. Buffalo is without WR Joshua Palmer, and two starting linemen, LT Dion Dawkins (ribs, no practice all week) and LG Alec Anderson (ankle), are questionable until inactives. Bills receivers Moore, Coleman, Kincaid and Shakir have no game designation.
